source: Expected outcomes and states are the Dart DeviceChatState (and the cache older-page rule) run over these inputs. desktop.* cases are what the production desktop chat handlers emitted, in wire order: a real ChatStateService over a temp V2 repository (transcript log, hex SHA-256 committed digests), read through the desktop runtime queries behind chat:get-state and chat:get-transcript-page, with chat:state-changed taken from the core.chat.events legacy stream through ChatStateDelivery and the body filter an undeclared bridge window gets; changes are committed with production chat commands (create tab, rename, dismiss question, reset to point) and repository transactions as the provider path commits them. gen.* cases are synthetic inputs. Regenerate with the scratch recorder apps/desktop-app/src/main/services/__tests__/__scratch__/record-chat-revision.test.ts, then apps/mobile/test/__scratch__/chat_revision_vectors_test.dart (neither is committed).
